title: EngineStatus
description: Output from WASM get_status: lifecycle flags, active rules snapshot, and last load error (v1). active_rules_version is integer or null only (not string), even if load_rules accepted a string rules_version elsewhere.

initialized.description: Whether the engine instance has been created and is usable.

schema_version.description: Engine / contract schema version string (free-form in v1).

active_rules_version.description: Integer revision of the currently active compiled ruleset, or null if none / not tracked as an integer.

rule_count.description: Number of rules in the active compiled ruleset.

last_load_ok.description: Whether the most recent load_rules attempt succeeded.

last_error.description: Structured error from the last failed load or null if no such error.

errorInfo.description: Same fields as error-info.schema.json; required code and message, optional rule_id and field. additionalProperties not restricted to match that schema.
